vulkanshaders.keybind.toast.no_active_pa: No active shader pack to reload.
vulkanshaders.screen.title: Hyaloclast [Shaders]
vulkanshaders.screen.tier.tooltip.tier_0: Pure Vulkan rasterization with Cascaded Shadow Maps, Hi-Z SSR, and GTAO.
vulkanshaders.screen.tier.tooltip.tier_1: Raster G-Buffer + compute Screen-Space Radiance Cache and diffuse GI.
vulkanshaders.screen.tier.tooltip.tier_2: Hybrid raster G-Buffer + inline VK_KHR_ray_query shadows, reflections, and GI.
vulkanshaders.screen.tier.tooltip.tier_3: Full Vulkan ray-traced path tracing with SHaRC radiance cache and overlay depth reprojection.
vulkanshaders.screen.upscaler.tooltip.no: Native resolution rendering without temporal upscaling.
vulkanshaders.screen.upscaler.tooltip.ts: Built-in Vulkan compute Temporal Super Resolution with Halton(2,3) jitter.
vulkanshaders.screen.upscaler.tooltip.fs: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 temporal upscaling backend.
vulkanshaders.screen.upscaler.tooltip.dl: NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution backend (requires RTX GPU + Streamline/NGX).
vulkanshaders.screen.denoiser.tooltip.sv: Built-in Vulkan compute Spatiotemporal Variance-Guided Filtering + À-Trous wavelet.
vulkanshaders.screen.denoiser.tooltip.dl: NVIDIA DLSS Ray Reconstruction (AI denoiser for Tier 2/3 RTX).
vulkanshaders.screen.framegen.tooltip.no: Native frame presentation without frame interpolation.
vulkanshaders.screen.framegen.tooltip.op: Built-in Vulkan compute Optical Flow + Async PresentThread frame interpolation.
vulkanshaders.screen.framegen.tooltip.dl: NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation backend (requires RTX 40+ + Optical Flow).
vulkanshaders.screen.shadow_res.tooltip: Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) per-cascade resolution for Tier 0 and Tier 1.
vulkanshaders.screen.shadow_dist.tooltip: Maximum distance in chunks for Cascaded Shadow Map caster rendering.
vulkanshaders.screen.hdr.tooltip: 16-bit scRGB / HDR10 PQ linear display output composition with SDR HUD overlay.
vulkanshaders.screen.overlay_depth.toolt: Reprojects Tier 3 path-traced primary hit depth into the main depth buffer for hand, weather, and block outlines.
vulkanshaders.screen.f3_debug.tooltip: Show compact Hyaloclast pack, render tier, upscaler, BLAS/TLAS, and VRAM stats on the F3 debug overlay.
vulkanshaders.screen.gpu_profiler.toolti: Display optional per-pass GPU timestamp breakdown on the F3 debug overlay.
vulkanshaders.screen.requires_vulkan: Enable Vulkan in Video Settings to use shaders.
vulkanshaders.screen.requires_pyroclast: Install Pyroclast (VulkanTurbo) to use shader packs.
